title: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
title_zh: F2G-Pose：用于直接RGB-D类别级物体姿态估计的几何感知基础特征提升

paragraphs.en: This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object’s 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. This task is highly ambiguous due to intra-class variations, symmetries, and partial observations. Current solutions struggle to balance reliability and efficiency: methods based on intermediate structures are prone to error propagation, while diffusion models suffer from high inference latency and complex post-hoc candidate extraction. To address this, we present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct, single-pass framework that predicts category-level pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape from a single RGB-D observation in one feed-forward pass. F2G-Pose lifts dense visual foundation features to partial point clouds, encodes local geometry with DGCNN tokenization, and integrates object-level structure with a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer. Joint size prediction and camera-frame shape completion encourage metric consistency through dense geometric supervision. With its task-specific network trained only on pose-annotated synthetic SOPE data and its frozen RADIO backbone externally pretrained, F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SOPE and ROPE while running at 28 FPS for pose-only inference, and further demonstrates strong camera-frame geometry on HouseCat6D and real-object transfer on HANDAL. Analyses of latency, robustness, shape completion, and GenPose++ candidate behavior further demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of F2G-Pose, with real-world manipulation experiments demonstrating deployment potential under segmented RGB-D inputs. The project page, code, and pretrained models are made available at https://jrryzh.github.io/F2G-Pose/ .

paragraphs.en: Category-level 6D object pose estimation recovers an object’s 3D rotation and translation without requiring an instance-specific CAD model or reference views at test time. In practical RGB-D perception, this estimate is often coupled with metric size and usable object geometry for benchmark evaluation [ 42 , 50 , 9 ] , physical interaction [ 37 , 38 , 6 ] , and robotic control [ 45 , 23 , 44 , 15 , 14 , 25 ] . This setting is inherently challenging because partial observations from a single crop or segmented point cloud provide incomplete evidence: symmetries induce rotational ambiguity, occlusions hide discriminative geometry, and intra-class variations alter shape, size, and appearance. Consequently, category-level perception must produce reliable metric predictions from ambiguous, incomplete, and noisy observations.
paragraphs.zh: 类别级6D物体位姿估计无需在测试时提供实例特定的CAD模型或参考视图，即可恢复物体的三维旋转和平移。 在实际的RGB-D感知中，该估计通常与度量尺寸和可用的物体几何相耦合，用于基准评估[42, 50, 9]、物理交互[37, 38, 6]以及机器人控制[45, 23, 44, 15, 14, 25]。 这一设定本质上具有挑战性，因为来自单个裁剪区域或分割点云的部分观测只能提供不完整的证据：对称性引发旋转歧义，遮挡隐藏了具有区分性的几何结构，而类内变化则改变了形状、尺寸和外观。 因此，类别级感知必须从模糊、不完整且有噪声的观测中产生可靠的度量预测。

paragraphs.en: Previous work has addressed this problem from two complementary directions. Deterministic category-level methods estimate pose and size through canonical coordinates [ 42 ] , correspondences [ 2 ] , shape priors [ 16 ] , deformation models [ 39 ] , alignment procedures [ 24 ] , or direct regression [ 26 , 43 , 17 ] . While these methods enable efficient inference, reliance on intermediate structures can lead to compounding errors. Under occlusion, missing depth, intra-class variation, and domain shift, the final metric estimate can become sensitive to the reliability of these intermediate structures. Direct regression can avoid some post-hoc alignment steps, but reliable direct prediction still requires representations that preserve local geometric cues and global object structure under partial observations.
paragraphs.zh: 以往的工作从两个互补的方向着手解决这一问题。 确定性的类别级方法通过规范坐标 [42]、对应关系 [2]、形状先验 [16]、形变模型 [39]、对齐流程 [24] 或直接回归 [26, 43, 17] 来估计位姿和尺寸。 虽然这些方法能够实现高效的推理，但对中间结构的依赖可能导致误差累积。 在遮挡、深度缺失、类内变化和域偏移的情况下，最终的度量估计可能会对这些中间结构的可靠性变得敏感。 直接回归可以避免某些事后的对齐步骤，但可靠的直接预测仍然需要能够在部分观测下保留局部几何线索和全局物体结构的表示。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line of work models pose ambiguity explicitly. GenPose [ 51 ] and GenPose++ [ 50 ] formulate category-level pose estimation as conditional pose distribution modeling, sampling multiple hypotheses and converting them into a prediction through scoring, filtering, clustering, or aggregation. This is principled for uncertainty representation, but it introduces a candidate-to-decision gap: deployed accuracy depends not only on the sampled hypotheses, but also on whether post-hoc extraction can select or aggregate a reliable representative. Moreover, this conversion must operate under a practical inference budget as in Fig. 3 , so sampling quality, candidate extraction, and computational cost become coupled. Joint-RegDiff [ 20 ] and RFMPose [ 32 ] improve generative pose inference through joint regression–diffusion learning with score-scaling sampling and Riemannian flow-matching trajectories, respectively, but both still rely on iterative generative inference to produce the prediction, so prediction quality remains coupled with sampling dynamics, candidate extraction, and inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 一条互补的研究路线对姿态歧义进行显式建模。 GenPose [51] 和 GenPose++ [50] 将类别级姿态估计形式化为条件姿态分布建模，采样多个假设，并通过打分、过滤、聚类或聚合将其转换为预测。 这在不确定性表示方面是有原则的，但它引入了从候选到决策的鸿沟：部署时的精度不仅取决于采样得到的假设，还取决于事后提取能否选出或聚合出一个可靠的代表。 此外，如图 3 所示，这一转换必须在实用的推理预算下进行，因此采样质量、候选提取与计算成本相互耦合。 Joint-RegDiff [20] 和 RFMPose [32] 分别通过带分数缩放采样的联合回归–扩散学习以及黎曼流匹配轨迹来改进生成式姿态推理，但二者仍依赖迭代式生成推理来产生预测，因此预测质量依然与采样动态、候选提取和推理成本相耦合。

paragraphs.en: We introduce F2G-Pose, a direct RGB-D framework that jointly estimates category-level pose, size, and camera-frame completed geometry in a single feed-forward pass. By leveraging geometry-aware foundation feature lifting and dense geometric supervision, it bypasses intermediate canonical shape alignment and avoids the sampling and candidate extraction used by sampling-based pose estimators. Specifically, we lift dense visual foundation features [ 13 ] to the partial point cloud for semantic cues, encode local geometry via DGCNN tokenization, and integrate object-level structure using a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer that provides conditional capacity across diverse shape regimes. Then, the pose-size head predicts the final metric estimate, while the shape head reconstructs camera-frame geometry as both auxiliary supervision and a usable output. This joint design encourages the shared representation to encode visible local evidence, object extent, and visible-to-complete geometric structure for consistent direct prediction under partial observations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 F2G-Pose，这是一个直接式的 RGB-D 框架，能够在单次前向传播中同时估计类别级位姿、尺寸以及相机坐标系下的补全几何。 通过利用几何感知的基础特征提升与稠密几何监督，它绕过了中间的规范形状对齐，并避免了基于采样的位姿估计器所使用的采样与候选提取过程。 具体而言，我们将稠密视觉基础特征 [ 13 ] 提升到部分点云上以获取语义线索，通过 DGCNN 分词编码局部几何，并使用混合专家 Transformer 整合物体级结构，从而在不同形状形态下提供条件化容量。 然后，位姿-尺寸头预测最终的度量估计结果，而形状头则重建相机坐标系下的几何，既作为辅助监督，也作为可用的输出。 这种联合设计促使共享表征编码可见的局部证据、物体范围以及从可见到完整的几何结构，从而在部分观测下实现一致的直接预测。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of this design, we train the task-specific network only on pose-annotated synthetic data from 149 SOPE categories [ 50 ] and test on SOPE [ 50 ] , ROPE [ 50 ] , HANDAL [ 10 ] , and HouseCat6D [ 17 ] . These benchmarks cover synthetic benchmark accuracy, synthetic-to-real transfer, additional real-object evaluation, and camera-frame shape reconstruction. F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while running at 28 FPS for pose inference. Beyond benchmark accuracy, we evaluate latency, robustness to perturbations and occlusion, shape reconstruction, GenPose++ candidate behavior, and real-world robotic manipulation. These results demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of direct feed-forward prediction, while robotic experiments demonstrate deployment potential under segmented RGB-D inputs.

paragraphs.en: Contributions. Our contributions are threefold: (1) We present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct RGB-D framework that predicts category-level 6D pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape in a single feed-forward pass, sharing its representation across pose, size, and shape learning. (2) We introduce geometry-aware foundation feature lifting to map dense visual features onto partial point clouds. DGCNN encodes local geometry, a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer integrates object-level structure, and camera-frame shape completion provides dense geometric supervision for metric prediction. (3) Extensive evaluations across synthetic benchmarks and real-world datasets demonstrate that F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, real-time inference, and high-quality shape completion. Furthermore, physical manipulation experiments demonstrate pick-and-place success, timely decision readiness, and deployment feasibility under segmented RGB-D inputs.

paragraphs.en: Category-Level 6D Pose Estimation. Category-level methods aim to generalize pose estimation across unseen object instances within a category [ 42 , 43 , 17 ] . Early works such as NOCS [ 42 ] introduced the notion of canonical space to enable pose alignment without requiring CAD models. Follow-up approaches [ 24 , 26 , 2 , 51 ] leveraged point cloud geometry and symmetry-aware losses to improve generalization. Some methods further incorporate shape-aware modeling [ 39 , 16 ] to jointly predict object size and shape. While these methods remove the need for object-specific models, many rely on intermediate canonical coordinates, correspondences, deformation fields, or shape priors whose reliability can degrade under occlusion, missing depth, and strong intra-category variation. Recent works have attempted to scale category-level 6D learning using larger and more diverse datasets [ 53 , 18 ] , making representation quality and inference efficiency increasingly important. Diffusion-based methods such as GenPose [ 51 ] and GenPose++ [ 50 ] model pose and size as multi-modal distributions, but often rely on auxiliary scoring networks to filter outlier samples. Joint-RegDiff [ 20 ] eliminates the need for such scoring networks through time-dependent score scaling, and RFMPose [ 32 ] formulates generative category-level pose estimation with Riemannian flow matching; however, both remain limited to 6D pose estimation and still require iterative generative inference, which generally increases inference cost and can limit real-time throughput.

paragraphs.en: Instance-Level Novel Object Pose Estimation. Another line of work estimates pose for novel object instances using CAD models [ 19 , 29 ] , single-view references, or multi-view references [ 21 , 27 , 11 ] . They often reconstruct object geometry, either explicitly via 3D modeling [ 28 , 22 ] or implicitly through image-based retrieval [ 12 , 30 ] . FoundationPose [ 46 ] supports either CAD or reference images, combining model-based and model-free paradigms. Recent foundation reconstruction models such as SAM 3D [ 35 ] reconstruct object geometry, texture, and layout from masked single images, targeting image-to-3D asset reconstruction in natural scenes. Together, these methods broaden object-centric 3D perception, but generally target instance-specific reconstruction or reference-conditioned alignment rather than category-level pose-size estimation under a fixed taxonomy. F2G-Pose targets this complementary category-level setting: it uses category-level canonical supervision during training, but requires only a segmented RGB-D observation at inference time for the evaluated taxonomy.

paragraphs.en: F2G-Pose uses RADIOv2.5 [ 13 ] to provide dense visual evidence for the partial RGB-D observation. RADIOv2.5 distills complementary 2D vision models [ 34 , 31 , 33 , 7 ] , combining dense feature extraction from SAM [ 34 ] with semantic features from DINOv2 [ 31 ] . Prior work has shown that DINOv2-style local features can support pose-consistent correspondences across object appearance and shape variation [ 52 , 54 ] . We use these features not as a standalone image prior, but as point-wise appearance and semantic cues attached to metric 3D observations. paragraphs.en: To increase representation capacity with conditional expert aggregation, we replace the standard feed-forward layers in each Transformer block with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers [ 5 , 8 , 4 ] . Each MoE layer contains an independent set of experts and uses a linear gating network to compute softmax probabilities over N e = 8 N_{e}=8 experts. For each token, we select the top-2 experts according to the gating scores, route the token to these experts, and aggregate their outputs using the selected probabilities renormalized to sum to one. A soft load-balancing penalty encourages balanced gate probabilities during training [ 36 ] . Finally, the encoded tokens are aggregated by global pooling to produce a compact object representation for direct 6D pose, size, and shape prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 为了通过条件专家聚合提升表征能力，我们将每个 Transformer 块中的标准前馈层替换为混合专家层 [5, 8, 4]。 每个混合专家层包含一组独立的专家，并使用线性门控网络在 N e = 8 N_{e}=8 个专家上计算 softmax 概率。 对于每个词元，我们根据门控分数选出 top-2 专家，将该词元路由到这些专家，并使用归一化为总和为 1 的被选概率来聚合它们的输出。 软负载均衡惩罚会在训练过程中促使门控概率保持均衡 [36]。 最后，通过全局池化聚合编码后的词元，生成一个紧凑的物体表征，用于直接进行 6D 位姿、尺寸和形状预测。

paragraphs.en: F2G-Pose uses two lightweight decoding branches on top of the shared object representation. The pose-size branch predicts the metric state directly, while the shape branch predicts complete geometry in the camera frame. Both branches are trained jointly, so dense geometric supervision can regularize the representation used for direct pose and size prediction without adding any test-time optimization or candidate extraction.
paragraphs.zh: F2G-Pose 在共享的目标表示之上使用了两个轻量级解码分支。 姿态-尺寸分支直接预测度量状态，而形状分支则在相机坐标系中预测完整几何。 两个分支联合训练，因此稠密几何监督能够对用于直接姿态和尺寸预测的表示进行正则化，而无需增加任何测试时优化或候选提取。

paragraphs.en: Pose and Size Estimation. The pose-size branch regresses rotation, translation, and metric size directly from the global object representation. This parameterization improves optimization stability while keeping the prediction deterministic and feed-forward. The branch outputs the final pose-size estimate directly, without sampling pose candidates or applying post-hoc aggregation.

paragraphs.en: Camera-Frame Shape Completion. From the extracted global feature vector, we first regress a coarse complete object shape 𝐏 coarse ∈ ℝ 512 × 3 \mathbf{P}_{\text{coarse}}\in\mathbb{R}^{512\times 3} using a lightweight MLP. Since the input partial point cloud 𝐏 \mathbf{P} contains observed metric geometry, we concatenate 𝐏 coarse \mathbf{P}_{\text{coarse}} with farthest-point-sampled observations from 𝐏 \mathbf{P} to form a combined point set, which is then processed through another MLP with a Sigmoid activation to produce a confidence score for each point. This selects reliable points for fusion, producing the refined fused point cloud 𝐏 fuse ∈ ℝ 512 × 3 \mathbf{P}_{\text{fuse}}\in\mathbb{R}^{512\times 3} . Finally, each point in 𝐏 fuse \mathbf{P}_{\text{fuse}} is augmented with the global feature vector and passed through an MLP to predict four local offsets per point, yielding 𝐏 dense ∈ ℝ 2048 × 3 \mathbf{P}_{\text{dense}}\in\mathbb{R}^{2048\times 3} . The shape is reconstructed directly in the camera frame, providing a geometry output and a dense auxiliary signal for learning metric-consistent object representations.

paragraphs.en: Datasets. We use SOPE [ 50 ] as the training source for F2G-Pose; it contains 5K synthetic object instances from 149 categories with category-level canonical pose, metric size, and complete shape supervision. Pose-size evaluation uses SOPE and ROPE [ 50 ] : SOPE measures synthetic benchmark performance, while ROPE evaluates transfer to scanned real objects under the same category taxonomy. For camera-frame geometry evaluation, we use SOPE and HouseCat6D [ 17 ] , where complete object geometry is available. For additional real-world transfer, we evaluate selected HANDAL objects [ 10 ] , including hammers, mugs, pans, and wrench-like tools. The 92 instances from seven HANDAL categories map to six SOPE categories; selection follows taxonomy correspondence. Thus, ROPE and this HANDAL subset evaluate seen-category, unseen-instance transfer (Appendix B.4 ).

paragraphs.en: Baselines and metrics. For category-level pose-size estimation, we compare with NOCS, SGPA, IST-Net, HS-Pose, GenPose, and GenPose++ using the SOPE/ROPE benchmark results reported by Omni6DPose [ 50 ] . Joint-RegDiff [ 20 ] and RFMPose [ 32 ] are report-only comparisons from their papers, using public metrics available under the SOPE/ROPE taxonomy. For reference-based comparisons on real datasets, we additionally report FoundationPose [ 46 ] and Any6D [ 21 ] . For runtime comparison, we benchmark executable methods under a unified inference protocol using the same segmentation masks, RGB-D crops, depth preprocessing, batch size 1, and GPU-synchronized timing on one RTX 4090; accuracy results follow the evaluation sources specified above. Pose-size accuracy is evaluated with AUC of 3D bounding-box IoU at thresholds 25/50/75, VUS under joint rotation-translation thresholds, and mean rotation/translation error. Shape completion is evaluated using Chamfer-L1 distance.

paragraphs.en: Pose-size accuracy and latency. Table 1 shows that F2G-Pose improves the accuracy-latency operating point of category-level RGB-D pose estimation. On SOPE, F2G-Pose improves GenPose++ from 31.9 to 43.7 AUC at IoU50 and reduces mean rotation error from 19.9 ∘ 19.9^{\circ} to 15.7 ∘ 15.7^{\circ} ; on ROPE, it improves AUC across all IoU thresholds and matches or exceeds the available high-precision VUS results. This gain is not only a speedup from removing iterative sampling. The larger improvement on IoU and rotation-sensitive metrics indicates that direct prediction benefits from stronger conditioning: dense image features preserve category and part cues, local point neighborhoods preserve observed surface evidence, and global token interactions integrate these cues into a metric pose-size estimate. At the same time, F2G-Pose runs at 28 FPS in pose-only mode and 24 FPS in full-model mode, compared with 4 FPS for GenPose++, yielding a single-pass estimate without candidate scoring, filtering, or clustering. More qualitative examples are provided in Appendix A.7 .
paragraphs.zh: 姿态与尺寸精度及延迟。 表1表明，F2G-Pose 改善了类别级 RGB-D 姿态估计在精度-延迟工作点上的表现。 在 SOPE 上，F2G-Pose 将 GenPose++ 在 IoU50 下的 AUC 从 31.9 提升至 43.7，并将平均旋转误差从 19.9 ∘ 19.9^{\circ} 降至 15.7 ∘ 15.7^{\circ}；在 ROPE 上，它在所有 IoU 阈值下都提升了 AUC，并达到或超过了现有高精度的 VUS 结果。 这一提升不仅仅是去除迭代采样带来的加速。 在 IoU 和对旋转敏感的指标上更大的改进表明，直接预测受益于更强的条件信息：密集图像特征保留了类别与部件线索，局部点邻域保留了观测到的表面证据，而全局 token 交互则将这些线索整合为一个度量性的姿态与尺寸估计。 同时，F2G-Pose 在仅姿态模式下运行速度为 28 FPS，在完整模型模式下为 24 FPS，而 GenPose++ 仅为 4 FPS，从而无需候选打分、筛选或聚类即可得到单次前向估计。 更多定性示例见附录 A.7。

sents.zh: 表1表明，F2G-Pose 改善了类别级 RGB-D 姿态估计在精度-延迟工作点上的表现。

sents.en: On SOPE, F2G-Pose improves GenPose++ from 31.9 to 43.7 AUC at IoU50 and reduces mean rotation error from 19.9 ∘ 19.9^{\circ} to 15.7 ∘ 15.7^{\circ} ; on ROPE, it improves AUC across all IoU thresholds and matches or exceeds the available high-precision VUS results.
sents.zh: 在 SOPE 上，F2G-Pose 将 GenPose++ 在 IoU50 下的 AUC 从 31.9 提升至 43.7，并将平均旋转误差从 19.9 ∘ 19.9^{\circ} 降至 15.7 ∘ 15.7^{\circ}；在 ROPE 上，它在所有 IoU 阈值下都提升了 AUC，并达到或超过了现有高精度的 VUS 结果。

sents.en: This gain is not only a speedup from removing iterative sampling.
sents.zh: 这一提升不仅仅是去除迭代采样带来的加速。

sents.en: The larger improvement on IoU and rotation-sensitive metrics indicates that direct prediction benefits from stronger conditioning: dense image features preserve category and part cues, local point neighborhoods preserve observed surface evidence, and global token interactions integrate these cues into a metric pose-size estimate.
sents.zh: 在 IoU 和对旋转敏感的指标上更大的改进表明，直接预测受益于更强的条件信息：密集图像特征保留了类别与部件线索，局部点邻域保留了观测到的表面证据，而全局 token 交互则将这些线索整合为一个度量性的姿态与尺寸估计。

sents.en: At the same time, F2G-Pose runs at 28 FPS in pose-only mode and 24 FPS in full-model mode, compared with 4 FPS for GenPose++, yielding a single-pass estimate without candidate scoring, filtering, or clustering.
sents.zh: 同时，F2G-Pose 在仅姿态模式下运行速度为 28 FPS，在完整模型模式下为 24 FPS，而 GenPose++ 仅为 4 FPS，从而无需候选打分、筛选或聚类即可得到单次前向估计。

paragraphs.en: Candidate-to-decision and time-budget analysis. Table 2 examines the candidate behavior of GenPose++ as a strong generative baseline. Its candidate distribution is heavy-tailed: although the median rotation error is only 8 ∘ 8^{\circ} , the mean rises to 39 ∘ 39^{\circ} , with 26.9% of sampled candidates exceeding 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} . With K = 50 K=50 samples, an oracle selects a candidate within 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} for 79.3% of instances, achieving a median error of 1.78 ∘ 1.78^{\circ} . However, a deployed pipeline must still score, filter, cluster, or aggregate these candidates, so its final prediction can be substantially worse than the oracle. This highlights the candidate-to-decision gap discussed in the introduction: candidate-set quality and deployed prediction quality are related but not equivalent. Candidate quality also varies with object structure; no-symmetry objects have the largest mean rotation error, suggesting that sampling difficulty is driven not only by pose ambiguity but also by distinctive yet partially observed geometry. Additional candidate diagnostics by symmetry are provided in Appendix A.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 候选到决策与时间预算分析。 表2考察了GenPose++作为一个强生成式基线的候选行为。 其候选分布呈重尾特征：虽然中位旋转误差仅为8 ∘ 8^{\circ}，但平均值升至39 ∘ 39^{\circ}，且有26.9%的采样候选超过45 ∘ 45^{\circ}。 在K = 50 K=50个样本的情况下，神谕选择器能在79.3%的实例中选出误差在5 ∘ 5^{\circ}以内的候选，实现1.78 ∘ 1.78^{\circ}的中位误差。 然而，部署的流水线仍必须对这些候选进行评分、过滤、聚类或聚合，因此其最终预测可能远差于神谕。 这凸显了引言中讨论的候选到决策差距：候选集质量与部署后的预测质量相关但并不等同。 候选质量还随物体结构而变化；无对称性物体的平均旋转误差最大，这表明采样难度不仅由位姿歧义驱动，还受独特但仅被部分观测到的几何结构影响。 按对称性划分的更多候选诊断见附录A.4。

paragraphs.en: Geometry output and shape completion. Table 4 evaluates camera-frame geometry output. The point-completion baselines are trained on the SOPE training split with the same partial-to-complete camera-frame targets. Compared with these geometry-only baselines [ 47 , 48 , 49 ] , F2G-Pose achieves substantially lower Chamfer-L1 error on both SOPE and HouseCat6D. The qualitative results in Fig. 2 show that F2G-Pose successfully reconstructs complete object geometries. Unlike these geometry-only completion baselines, F2G-Pose predicts shape from a shared RGB-D representation: depth points anchor the visible metric surface, and lifted RGB foundation features provide category, texture, and part cues for completing occluded regions. Since the completed geometry is predicted directly in the camera frame, it can also be consumed by simple downstream planning modules without an additional canonical-to-camera alignment step. Because the inputs and supervision differ across systems and camera-frame CD also reflects global alignment, Appendix B.1 provides an additional matched RGB-D canonical-frame comparison.

paragraphs.en: Component ablation. Table 4 isolates the main design factors of F2G-Pose on ROPE. Removing RGB foundation features leads to the largest performance drop, particularly on the rotation-sensitive VUS metrics, showing that point-wise visual lifting provides pose-relevant appearance and semantic cues beyond partial geometry alone. Replacing the MoE Transformer with a parameter-equivalent dense FFN also reduces accuracy, suggesting that conditional capacity helps model category-level object diversity. Removing auxiliary shape supervision further degrades pose-size prediction, indicating that dense camera-frame geometry supervision regularizes the shared RGB-D representation and directly benefits the final pose-size estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 组件消融实验。 表 4 在 ROPE 上分离了 F2G-Pose 的主要设计因素。 移除 RGB 基础特征导致最大的性能下降，尤其是在旋转敏感的 VUS 指标上，这表明逐点的视觉提升提供了超出单纯部分几何的与姿态相关的外观和语义线索。 用参数量相当的稠密 FFN 替换 MoE Transformer 也会降低精度，这表明条件化容量有助于建模类别级物体的多样性。 移除辅助形状监督进一步降低了姿态-尺寸预测的性能，这表明稠密的相机坐标系几何监督对共享的 RGB-D 表示起到了正则化作用，并直接有益于最终的姿态-尺寸估计。

paragraphs.en: Representation analysis. Table 6 studies how different RGB-D representations affect direct pose-size prediction. All variants are trained with the same pose-size losses, while varying the feature aggregation strategy, contextual encoder, foundation backbone, and the use of auxiliary shape supervision. Replacing global feature pooling with DGCNN tokens improves both IoU and rotation-sensitive VUS, showing that local surface neighborhoods provide important geometric cues for direct pose estimation. Adding Transformer context further improves performance by integrating local RGB-D evidence into an object-level representation. The full model achieves the best results, indicating that local geometric tokenization, object-level context, and camera-frame geometry supervision are complementary. Finally, replacing RADIO with DINOv2 or CLIP causes only modest degradation in IoU50, suggesting that the improvement is driven primarily by the architecture and supervision rather than by a specific foundation backbone. Additional backbone, routing, and shape-decoder ablations are summarized in Appendix A.6 .

paragraphs.en: MoE routing analysis. Table 6 shows that top-2 MoE provides a favorable accuracy-latency trade-off. Top-1 routing is faster but less accurate, while top-4 brings only marginal accuracy gains at a higher latency cost. Compared with top-2 routing without balancing, the load-balanced top-2 MoE achieves higher routing entropy, lower load concentration, and better pose accuracy. These results suggest that balanced conditional capacity improves the shared RGB-D representation while keeping inference cost moderate. Further instance-level analysis finds overlapping category-related expert preferences (Appendix B.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Robustness under challenging materials. Table 7 reports performance on transparent and reflective objects, which often corrupt depth observations. Compared with the overall ROPE performance, F2G-Pose shows moderate degradation on these material subsets, with reflective objects being more difficult than transparent ones, especially in VUS and Chamfer distance. The performance drop is most apparent in IoU75, where depth holes, specular artifacts, and missing thin structures can perturb the estimated object extent. A similar trend is observed on HouseCat6D, where reconstruction remains accurate for many transparent objects because their shapes are regular despite noisy depth. Overall, F2G-Pose remains reasonably robust under material-induced sensing noise, while precise box alignment is still sensitive to imperfect depth observations. Controlled RGB and depth perturbation results are reported in Appendix A.3 , with additional material examples in Fig. 9 . SAM-mask and controlled erosion/dilation results are provided in Appendix B.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 在具有挑战性的材质下的鲁棒性。 表 7 报告了在透明和反光物体上的性能，这类物体常常会破坏深度观测。 与整体的 ROPE 性能相比，F2G-Pose 在这些材质子集上表现出中度退化，其中反光物体比透明物体更难，尤其是在 VUS 和 Chamfer 距离上。 性能下降在 IoU75 上最为明显，深度空洞、镜面伪影以及细小结构的缺失都会干扰对物体范围的估计。 在 HouseCat6D 上也观察到类似的趋势：尽管深度存在噪声，但由于许多透明物体的形状较为规则，其重建仍然保持准确。 总体而言，F2G-Pose 在材质引起的传感噪声下仍具有相当的鲁棒性，但精确的框对齐仍对不完美的深度观测较为敏感。 受控的 RGB 和深度扰动结果报告于附录 A.3，更多的材质示例见图 9。 SAM 掩膜以及受控的腐蚀/膨胀结果提供于附录 B.2。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 evaluates cross-dataset transfer on real-world manipulable objects captured under different setups. The zero-/one-reference baseline protocols are detailed in Appendix B.5 . paragraphs.en: Robot manipulation. We validate the final pose-size decision in a real pick-and-place setup using an ARX robotic arm, a parallel-jaw gripper, and an external RealSense RGB-D camera. All methods receive the same object masks and RGB-D crops, and the evaluated objects include bottles, bowls, cans, mugs, cups, hammers, pans, and wrench-like tools. The predicted pose and metric size determine the grasp approach and placement target; the completed camera-frame shape is used only for collision checking. Each trial randomizes object placement within a tabletop start region, and success requires grasping, transporting, and placing the object at the target without dropping or collision. The full model achieves 74/80 successful picks and 68/80 successful placements.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人操作。 我们在使用 ARX 机械臂、平行夹爪和外部 RealSense RGB-D 相机的真实抓取与放置设置中验证最终的位姿与尺寸决策。 所有方法接收相同的物体掩码和 RGB-D 裁剪图像，评估的物体包括瓶子、碗、罐子、马克杯、杯子、锤子、平底锅和扳手类工具。 预测的位姿和度量尺寸决定抓取 approach 和放置目标；补全后的相机坐标系形状仅用于碰撞检测。 每次试验都会在桌面起始区域内随机放置物体，成功标准是抓取、搬运并将物体放置到目标位置，且不发生掉落或碰撞。 完整模型实现了 74/80 的成功抓取和 68/80 的成功放置。

paragraphs.en: We present F2G-Pose, a direct RGB-D framework that estimates category-level 6D pose, metric size, and camera-frame shape from a single observation. By lifting dense visual foundation features to partial point clouds and encoding local-global geometry with a MoE Transformer, F2G-Pose predicts the deployed pose-size state in one feed-forward pass. Experiments on SOPE, ROPE, HouseCat6D, HANDAL, and ARX manipulation show a favorable balance of accuracy, inference latency, and manipulation success, while the shape branch provides dense geometric supervision and approximate planning geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 F2G-Pose，一个直接的 RGB-D 框架，可从单次观测中估计类别级 6D 位姿、度量尺寸以及相机坐标系下的形状。 通过将密集的视觉基础模型特征提升为局部点云，并使用 MoE Transformer 编码局部-全局几何信息，F2G-Pose 在一次前向传播中预测出部署所需的位姿-尺寸状态。 在 SOPE、ROPE、HouseCat6D、HANDAL 以及 ARX 操作任务上的实验表明，该方法在精度、推理延迟和操作成功率之间取得了良好的平衡，同时形状分支还能提供密集的几何监督和近似的规划几何。

sents.en: Experiments on SOPE, ROPE, HouseCat6D, HANDAL, and ARX manipulation show a favorable balance of accuracy, inference latency, and manipulation success, while the shape branch provides dense geometric supervision and approximate planning geometry.
sents.zh: 在 SOPE、ROPE、HouseCat6D、HANDAL 以及 ARX 操作任务上的实验表明，该方法在精度、推理延迟和操作成功率之间取得了良好的平衡，同时形状分支还能提供密集的几何监督和近似的规划几何。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. F2G-Pose assumes a segmented RGB-D crop at inference time, so mask failures and severe depth corruption can propagate to pose, size, and shape. The method remains sensitive to thin or asymmetric parts, severe occlusion, and symmetric low-texture objects that admit multiple plausible rotations. High-precision metric alignment remains weak under cross-dataset domain shift, which may require downstream refinement for tasks with tight geometric tolerances. Symmetry-aware supervision does not eliminate ambiguity under severe occlusion or near-symmetry, and the model provides no calibrated uncertainty or abstention mechanism. Future work will address mask-free operation, broader real-object coverage, articulated or deformable categories, and active perception for heavy occlusion.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 F2G-Pose 在推理时假设输入为已分割的 RGB-D 裁剪区域，因此掩码失败和严重的深度损坏可能会传播到智能体位姿、尺寸和形状。 该方法对细小或不对称的部件、严重遮挡以及存在多个合理旋转的对称低纹理物体仍然敏感。 在跨数据集的领域偏移下，高精度的度量对齐仍然较弱，对于几何公差要求严格的任务，可能需要下游的进一步精化。 对称性感知的监督并不能消除严重遮挡或近似对称情况下的歧义，且该模型不提供经过校准的不确定性估计或弃权机制。 未来的工作将解决无掩码运行、更广泛的真实物体覆盖、铰接或可变形类别，以及应对严重遮挡的主动感知等问题。

paragraphs.en: F2G-Pose receives a segmented RGB crop and its corresponding partial point cloud. We sample 1024 points from the segmented depth observation and concatenate each point coordinate with a lifted visual feature. Frozen RADIOv2.5-L [ 13 ] provides feature maps from layers 8, 16, and 23. Independent 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutional blocks compress each map from 1024 to 512 channels. Learned softmax-normalized layer weights combine them by summation, followed by a 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional block producing 1024 channels; both convolutional stages use BatchNorm and ReLU. We gather each point’s feature by integer-dividing its crop-pixel coordinates by the patch size of 16. This produces an input tensor of size B × 1024 × 1027 B\times 1024\times 1027 .
paragraphs.zh: F2G-Pose 接收一个分割后的 RGB 图像裁剪及其对应的局部点云。 我们从分割后的深度观测中采样 1024 个点，并将每个点的坐标与提升后的视觉特征拼接。 冻结的 RADIOv2.5-L [13] 提供来自第 8、16 和 23 层的特征图。 独立的 1 × 1 1\times 1 卷积模块将每个特征图从 1024 通道压缩到 512 通道。 通过学习得到的经 softmax 归一化的层权重将它们按求和方式融合，随后经过一个 3 × 3 3\times 3 卷积模块生成 1024 通道；两个卷积阶段均使用 BatchNorm 和 ReLU。 我们将每个点的裁剪像素坐标整数除以 16 的补丁大小，从而获取每个点的特征。 这就产生了一个大小为 B × 1024 × 1027 B\times 1024\times 1027 的输入张量。

sents.en: Learned softmax-normalized layer weights combine them by summation, followed by a 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional block producing 1024 channels; both convolutional stages use BatchNorm and ReLU.
sents.zh: 通过学习得到的经 softmax 归一化的层权重将它们按求和方式融合，随后经过一个 3 × 3 3\times 3 卷积模块生成 1024 通道；两个卷积阶段均使用 BatchNorm 和 ReLU。

sents.en: We gather each point’s feature by integer-dividing its crop-pixel coordinates by the patch size of 16.
sents.zh: 我们将每个点的裁剪像素坐标整数除以 16 的补丁大小，从而获取每个点的特征。

sents.en: This produces an input tensor of size B × 1024 × 1027 B\times 1024\times 1027 .
sents.zh: 这就产生了一个大小为 B × 1024 × 1027 B\times 1024\times 1027 的输入张量。

paragraphs.en: The fused RGB-D point set is tokenized by a DGCNN encoder with two downsampling stages, reducing 1024 input points to 128 object tokens. The tokens are projected to 512 dimensions and processed by 8 Transformer blocks with 8 attention heads. In the full model, each Transformer feed-forward layer is replaced by a top-2 Mixture-of-Experts layer with 8 experts and the load-balancing loss described in the main paper. A learned softmax-weighted sum combines the block outputs; an MLP projects the tokens to 1024 dimensions before max pooling. The pose-size branch directly regresses rotation, translation, and metric size. The shape branch predicts 512 initial points, concatenates 256 farthest-point-sampled observed points, scores the 768 candidates and retains 512, then predicts four local offsets per retained point for a 2048-point completed shape. The selected 512 points and final 2048 points receive reconstruction supervision. Continuous rotational symmetries use 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} candidate sampling; objects with at least two continuously symmetric axes are excluded from the rotation loss.
paragraphs.zh: 融合后的RGB-D点集由一个DGCNN编码器进行分词，该编码器包含两个下采样阶段，将1024个输入点缩减为128个物体词元。 这些词元被投影到512维，并由8个具有8个注意力头的Transformer块进行处理。 在完整模型中，每个Transformer前馈层都被替换为一个包含8个专家的top-2专家混合层，并采用正文所述的负载均衡损失。 通过可学习的softmax加权求和来合并各块的输出；一个MLP在最大池化之前将词元投影到1024维。 姿态-尺寸分支直接回归旋转、平移和公制尺寸。 形状分支预测512个初始点，拼接256个通过最远点采样得到的观测点，对这768个候选点进行评分并保留512个，然后为每个保留点预测四个局部偏移量，从而得到一个2048点的完整形状。 被选中的512个点和最终的2048个点均接受重建监督。 连续旋转对称性使用1 ∘ 1^{\circ}候选采样；具有至少两条连续对称轴的物体被排除在旋转损失之外。

paragraphs.en: F2G-Pose is trained only on the SOPE training split used in the main experiments. We train for 100 epochs with batch size 512 using AdamW. The initial learning rate is 10 − 4 10^{-4} , the weight decay is 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , and a LambdaLR schedule decays the learning rate by a factor of 0.9 every 8 epochs with a lower bound of 2% of the initial value. BatchNorm momentum is decayed from 0.9 by a factor of 0.5 every 3 epochs with a minimum value of 0.01. Training experiments are run with PyTorch 2.4 and CUDA 12.4 using automatic mixed precision, DistributedDataParallel, and synchronized BatchNorm on 4 NVIDIA H200 GPUs.

paragraphs.en: Table 12 breaks down the GenPose++ candidate set by object symmetry. paragraphs.en: The qualitative failure cases are drawn from ROPE and are consistent with the limitations stated in the paper: corrupted depth on thin or reflective structures, heavy occlusion, and ambiguous rotations for symmetric or weakly textured objects.

paragraphs.en: Reflective or transparent surfaces often produce missing or distorted depth. paragraphs.zh: 反射性或透明表面通常会导致深度缺失或失真。 RADIO 特征提供了互补的外观线索，但当观测到的点云丢失细长把手、锐利边缘或不对称部件时，它们仍无法完全恢复度量尺度。 如图 6 所示，这导致了高精度的 IoU 和旋转误差。

paragraphs.en: Table 13 summarizes additional ablations while avoiding new claims beyond the current method. The RGB ablation confirms that lifted foundation features are a major contributor under partial depth. The MoE variants show that top-2 routing is the adopted trade-off: top-4 gives only a marginal gain over top-2 at higher cost, while top-1 is faster but less accurate. The backbone variants show that the framework remains effective with DINOv2 or CLIP, although RADIO gives the best result. The shape-decoder variants indicate that point selection and coarse-to-fine refinement also affect pose-size accuracy through the shared representation.

paragraphs.en: The camera-frame comparison in Table 4 measures the complete prediction system: its Chamfer distance includes intrinsic reconstruction error and global pose, translation, and scale error. Moreover, the geometry-only baselines and F2G-Pose receive different input information and supervision. To control these factors, we compare F2G-Pose and AdaPoinTr using identical RGB-D inputs, including features from the same frozen RADIO encoder, and predict shapes directly in a normalized canonical frame. Each architecture is evaluated with and without pose-size supervision; no ground-truth pose or scale is supplied as input.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SAM-predicted masks on ROPE and controlled erosion/dilation of ground-truth masks for pose estimation on ROPE and shape completion on SOPE. Erosion removes foreground evidence, while dilation includes background. Tables 15 and 16 report the results at the stated mask-IoU levels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ROPE 上评估 SAM 预测的掩码，以及对真值掩码进行受控腐蚀/膨胀后的掩码，分别用于 ROPE 上的位姿估计和 SOPE 上的形状补全。 腐蚀会去除前景证据，而膨胀则会纳入背景。 表 15 和表 16 报告了在所述掩码 IoU 水平下的结果。

sents.en: We evaluate SAM-predicted masks on ROPE and controlled erosion/dilation of ground-truth masks for pose estimation on ROPE and shape completion on SOPE.
sents.zh: 我们在 ROPE 上评估 SAM 预测的掩码，以及对真值掩码进行受控腐蚀/膨胀后的掩码，分别用于 ROPE 上的位姿估计和 SOPE 上的形状补全。

sents.en: Tables 15 and 16 report the results at the stated mask-IoU levels.
sents.zh: 表 15 和表 16 报告了在所述掩码 IoU 水平下的结果。

paragraphs.en: SAM masks yield results close to the GT-mask baseline. At matched mask IoU, erosion causes greater degradation than dilation on most pose metrics and on shape CD, suggesting that missing foreground is generally more harmful than limited background inclusion. Together with the RGB and depth perturbations in Appendix A.3 , these results characterize input sensitivity; they do not remove the requirement for segmented RGB-D input.
paragraphs.zh: SAM 掩码得到的结果接近 GT 掩码基线。 在相同掩码 IoU 下，腐蚀在大多数位姿指标和形状 CD 上造成的退化比膨胀更严重，这表明缺失前景通常比包含少量背景更有害。 结合附录 A.3 中的 RGB 和深度扰动，这些结果刻画了输入敏感性；它们并不能免除对分割后 RGB-D 输入的要求。

paragraphs.en: Beyond load balance, we analyze instance-level routing over 7,466 object samples. Routing exhibits an association with category (Cramér’s V = 0.306 V=0.306 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Different experts show preferences for broad geometry-related groups, including bag-like, flat, and bowl-like objects, with substantial overlap. This suggests distributed specialization rather than a rigid one-expert-per-category partition. Associations with material and visibility are weaker, and no significant independent association with symmetry was found. These observations complement the capacity and balance analysis in Table 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 除负载均衡之外，我们还在 7,466 个物体样本上分析了实例级路由。 路由与类别存在关联（Cramér's V = 0.306，p < 0.001）。 不同的专家对宽泛的几何相关类别表现出偏好，包括袋状、扁平状和碗状物体，且存在大量重叠。 这表明存在分布式的专门化，而非每个类别固定对应单个智能体的僵硬划分。 与材质和可见性的关联较弱，且未发现与对称性存在显著的独立关联。 这些观察结果补充了表 6 中的容量与均衡分析。

sents.zh: 除负载均衡之外，我们还在 7,466 个物体样本上分析了实例级路由。

sents.en: These observations complement the capacity and balance analysis in Table 6 .
sents.zh: 这些观察结果补充了表 6 中的容量与均衡分析。

paragraphs.en: HANDAL is an independent real-world dataset with sensing conditions, capture environments, and object instances distinct from SOPE. Among its 17 categories, we evaluate the seven with direct semantic correspondences to the SOPE taxonomy. Selection is based on taxonomy correspondence, not model performance. The remaining categories have ambiguous mappings or no direct SOPE counterparts and are excluded because no corresponding canonical frame is defined. These seven categories map to six SOPE categories, with both wrench types mapped to spanner .
paragraphs.zh: HANDAL 是一个独立的真实世界数据集，其感知条件、采集环境和物体实例均与 SOPE 不同。 在其 17 个类别中，我们评估了与 SOPE 分类体系存在直接语义对应关系的七个类别。 类别的选择基于分类体系的对应关系，而非模型性能。 其余类别或者映射不明确，或者在 SOPE 中没有直接对应类别，由于未定义相应的规范坐标系而未被纳入。 这七个类别映射到六个 SOPE 类别，其中两种扳手类型均映射到 spanner。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation covers 92 instances. The macro-average AUCs are 35.0, 11.7, and 0.3 at IoU25, IoU50, and IoU75. These results indicate coarse 3D alignment under cross-dataset transfer, while precise joint estimation of pose, size, and extent remains challenging. Both ROPE and this HANDAL subset evaluate seen-category, unseen-instance transfer, rather than unseen-category generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 评估涵盖92个实例。 在IoU25、IoU50和IoU75下，宏平均AUC分别为35.0、11.7和0.3。 这些结果表明在跨数据集迁移下仅能实现粗略的3D对齐，而对位姿、尺寸和范围的精确联合估计仍然具有挑战性。 ROPE和该HANDAL子集评估的都是已见类别、未见实例的迁移，而非未见类别的泛化。

paragraphs.en: “Zero reference” means that no additional reference view is supplied beyond the test RGB-D observation. We use the official repository’s reference-free image-to-3D pathway, which reconstructs a coarse shape from the test observation and subsequently estimates pose using that reconstructed shape.
paragraphs.zh: 「零参考」指除测试 RGB-D 观测外，不提供任何额外的参考视图。 我们使用官方仓库中的免参考图像到三维路径，该路径从测试观测重建粗略形状，随后利用该重建形状估计位姿。

paragraphs.en: We randomly sample one additional view of the same object from its ROPE multi-view sequence as the reference image and apply the standard reference-query inference protocol.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the model-free pathway under the same one-reference constraint. One additional real view of the same object is randomly sampled from its ROPE sequence; an object mesh is reconstructed from that view and used for pose estimation.
